lines.text: Which ball lands first? One thrown sideways, one just dropped.
lines.phonemes: wˌɪtʃ bˈɔːl lˈændz fˈɜːst? wˈʌn θɹˈoʊn sˈaɪdweɪz, wˈʌn dʒˈʌst dɹˈɑːpt.

lines.text: First, just the drop, slowed twenty times. Ghosts every twentieth of a second, and the gaps keep growing: a falling ball speeds up the whole way down.
lines.phonemes: fˈɜːst, dʒˈʌst ðə dɹˈɑːp, slˈoʊd twˈɛnti tˈaɪmz. ɡˈoʊsts ˈɛvɹi twˈɛntiəθ əvə sˈɛkənd, ænd ðə ɡˈæps kˈiːp ɡɹˈoʊɪŋ: ɐ fˈɔːlɪŋ bˈɔːl spˈiːdz ˌʌp ðə hˈoʊl wˈeɪ dˈaʊn.

lines.text: Now throw one sideways: same height, same instant. It flies twenty centimeters farther… and still lands on the same frame.
lines.phonemes: nˈaʊ θɹˈoʊ wˈʌn sˈaɪdweɪz: sˈeɪm hˈaɪt, sˈeɪm ˈɪnstənt. ɪt flˈaɪz twˈɛnti sˈɛntɪmˌiːɾɚz fˈɑːɹðɚ… ænd stˈɪl lˈændz ɔnðə sˈeɪm fɹˈeɪm.

lines.text: Old gunnery books drew cannonballs flying straight, then dropping. Galileo saw two motions at once: a steady glide across, plus a fall. Gravity pulls only down, so at every tick, both sit at the same height.
lines.phonemes: ˈoʊld ɡˈʌnɚɹi bˈʊks dɹˈuː kˈænənbˌɔːlz flˈaɪɪŋ stɹˈeɪt, ðˈɛn dɹˈɑːpɪŋ. ɡˌælɪlˈeɪoʊ sˈɔː tˈuː mˈoʊʃənz ɐtwˈʌns: ɐ stˈɛdi ɡlˈaɪd əkɹˈɑːs, plˈʌs ɐ fˈɔːl. ɡɹˈævᵻɾi pˈʊlz ˈoʊnli dˈaʊn, sˌoʊ æɾ ˈɛvɹi tˈɪk, bˈoʊθ sˈɪt æt ðə sˈeɪm hˈaɪt.

lines.text: Throw twice as hard, then three times: forty centimeters, then sixty. Every row of ghosts stays level, and all four land on the same frame.
lines.phonemes: θɹˈoʊ twˈaɪs æz hˈɑːɹd, ðˈɛn θɹˈiː tˈaɪmz: fˈɔːɹɾi sˈɛntɪmˌiːɾɚz , ðˈɛn sˈɪksti. ˈɛvɹi ɹˈoʊ ʌv ɡˈoʊsts stˈeɪz lˈɛvəl, ænd ˈɔːl fˈɔːɹ lˈænd ɔnðə sˈeɪm fɹˈeɪm.

lines.text: Measure it: nine gaps, a twentieth of a second each. A one-meter fall takes about point four five seconds, thrown or dropped.
lines.phonemes: mˈɛʒɚɹ ɪt: nˈaɪn ɡˈæps, ˈeɪ twˈɛntiəθ əvə sˈɛkənd ˈiːtʃ. ɐ wˈʌnmˈiːɾɚ fˈɔːl tˈeɪks ɐbˌaʊt pˈɔɪnt fˈɔːɹ fˈaɪv sˈɛkəndz, θɹˈoʊn ɔːɹ dɹˈɑːpt.

lines.text: Speed decides where a ball lands. Height alone decides when. That holds even for a bullet fired level.
lines.phonemes: spˈiːd dᵻsˈaɪdz wˌɛɹ ɐ bˈɔːl lˈændz. hˈaɪt ɐlˈoʊn dᵻsˈaɪdz wˈɛn. ðæt hˈoʊldz ˈiːvən fɚɹə bˈʊlɪt fˈaɪɚd lˈɛvəl.

lines.text: Next: one pendulum, big swing against small. It's almost a tie.
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: wˈʌn pˈɛndʒuːləm, bˈɪɡ swˈɪŋ ɐɡˈɛnst smˈɔːl. ɪts ˈɔːlmoʊst ɐ tˈaɪ.
